question: I really love the atmosphere of the town on Elbaph!! Were there any countries or towns used as models? Pen Name "Hinasuke"
answer: I'm happy, because it took quite a while to design Elbaph. Thank you! Of course, the model is the buildings from the era of Viking in Scandinavia, and I imagined the culture and topography from there! It's the same village as in volume 86, but I drew it at an angle so it wouldn't be out of place and it wouldn't reveal it was on top of a huge tree.
